brief.objective: Create a coherent original game visual family spanning character, world, HUD, icons, collectible, and environment while preserving gameplay readability at actual scale.
brief.audience: A player reading state, danger, and collectible affordances quickly during a short play session.
brief.surface: Original 2D exploration game slice named Tidelane, with HUD and art-family assets.
acceptance_criteria: Character, world, HUD, icon, collectible, and environment assets share silhouette, palette, material, lighting, and perspective grammar.
Player, danger, collectible, objective, and interaction states remain legible at intended in-game scale.
HUD typography and controls are code-native, responsive, and separate from decorative art assets.
The family is original and does not rely on protected characters, worlds, logos, or recognizable franchises.
Alpha edges, anchors, frame dimensions, fallback/loading states, and performance characteristics are inspected.

inputs.content: Original Tidelane 2D exploration family: ink navy, sea-glass teal, warm coral, salt cream; side-on orthographic read; weathered paper and sea-glass material; HUD text remains code-native.

references.notes: Use cel-shaded, tidepool-inspired visual grammar for an original family; do not copy protected expression.
Use the relationship between HUD, character silhouette, environment tile, and collectible as family evidence.
Preserve readable value separation between player, hazard, collectible, and HUD states.
Use sea-glass, ink, and warm coral material cues consistently across the family.

must_include: Anchor/origin, frame size, alpha, and intended display scale for each raster asset
must_avoid: Protected game characters, franchises, logos, or copied UI motifs
HUD text baked into raster art
Detail that hides danger, player, collectible, or objective state
Unbounded glow/neon, arbitrary icon styles, mismatched perspective
Approving a family from a single isolated asset
technology: Game runtime or game-ui specialist for playable surface
SVG/raster sprites with explicit anchor, alpha, and frame contract
accessibility: Pair color-coded state with shape, icon, label, or motion-independent cue.
Respect reduced motion and provide readable UI labels at supported scales.
Provide keyboard/touch alternatives for HUD interaction.
responsive: At 390x844, HUD scales/reflows without covering player, objective, or interaction target.
At 800x600, gameplay readability and icon separation remain intact.
At 1280x720, the family reads as one world rather than unrelated assets.
constraints.notes: Art bible: 2D exploration; side-on shallow layered depth; rounded utility forms with one angular navigation cue; ink navy/sea-glass teal/warm coral/salt cream; weathered paper and sea-glass; soft directional dusk light; orthographic side-on perspective; feet/base anchor for character and bottom-center anchor for HUD icons. Product specificity: hide the fixture title and judge whether material, silhouette, palette, and readable game states still belong to Tidelane. Performance: inspect texture dimensions, alpha edges, atlas/frame consistency, load/fallback, and small-scale use. Edit when family identity/readability is sound and one local sprite/icon/alpha/anchor/HUD placement needs correction; regenerate when direction, silhouette language, or family consistency is structurally wrong across roles. Stop at threshold, readability block, no material correction, budget exhaustion, tool block, or marginal improvement.

states.description: Playable frame with stable HUD and character/world read.
Objective cue is readable and anchored.
Damage state is perceivable without color alone.
Collectible silhouette and affordance remain distinct.
Interaction target and action cue are readable.
Pause state keeps essential status and recovery clear.
Loading state preserves honest fallback and layout.
Missing asset fallback does not misrepresent a final approved asset.
Assets are inspected at intended 1x display scale.

expected_artifacts.role: silhouette scale anchor alpha family and performance inspection

immutable: Original Tidelane art-bible constraints and gameplay state meanings
Code-native HUD copy and interaction semantics
Asset role separation between world art, sprites, HUD, and effects
high_sensitivity: Anchor, frame dimensions, alpha edges, palette value separation, and scale
Family consistency across all visual roles
flexible: Exact character anatomy, environment composition, effect treatment, secondary icon geometry, engine, and atlas layout
forbidden_inference: Do not import recognizable IP, franchise lore, logos, or copied UI identity.
Do not treat the style sheet as a finished playable output or proof of runtime behavior.
